name: vibe-coding-library
description: Engineering playbooks for any MCP coding agent: find a method, load its current prompt and follow its verification workflow.

interface.longDescription: Vibe Coding Library helps coding agents choose engineering workflows over MCP Streamable HTTP. Discover actual domains and canonical English topic keys, select the requested operation, and load the current prompt with its required context and conditional next steps. All 241 workflow IDs are backed by validated topic membership. Free-text search supports four catalog languages and conservative typo repair for registered vocabulary. The calling agent interprets the user’s goal and applies the retrieved method with its own tools, rules and permissions. Relevant verification and repeated Patch Checking preserve evidence between stages. The two read-only tools require no publisher account or API key and do not inspect or modify a repository. Technical instructions are English.
defaultPrompt: Fix stale cache after a write using the relevant engineering workflow.
Review this patch and verify the resulting change.
Verify MCP tool discovery and authorization.

publication.release_notes: Vibe Coding Library 1.6.1 fixes missing authorization synonyms and adds catalog-first discovery. Agents can enumerate actual domains and canonical English topic keys, then retrieve exact workflow members without inventing query words. All 241 workflows have validated subject tags; subject matches rank ahead of incidental mentions. Free-text search and all previous request/result formats remain compatible. The console offers guided topic selection and a recovery path for empty text results. No embedding provider, API key or user-query transfer to an AI service is added. Registered-vocabulary spelling repair accepts one unambiguous edit or adjacent transposition. Exact topic/ID arguments remain strict, and ambiguous text corrections are left for catalog selection.

es-ES.subtitle: Flujos de código bajo demanda
es-ES.description: Métodos de ingeniería para cualquier agente de código con MCP por Streamable HTTP. Busca entre 241 entradas por objetivo o síntoma y carga el paso actual, sus instrucciones y una secuencia condicional de reparación y verificación. Búsqueda en inglés, español, ruso y chino simplificado; instrucciones técnicas en inglés. Herramientas de solo lectura, sin cuenta ni clave API del editor.

ru-RU.subtitle: Сценарии разработки по запросу
ru-RU.description: Инженерные workflow для кодинговых агентов с MCP через Streamable HTTP. Поиск среди 241 сценария по задаче или симптому и загрузка текущего промпта с инструкциями и условной цепочкой исправления и проверок. Поиск на английском, испанском, русском и упрощённом китайском; технические инструкции на английском. Два тула работают только на чтение, аккаунт и API-ключ издателя не нужны.

zh-CN.subtitle: 按需加载开发工作流
zh-CN.description: 适用于支持 MCP Streamable HTTP 的编码代理。根据任务目标或故障症状搜索 241 个工程入口，加载当前提示、领域说明及带条件的修复与验证步骤。搜索支持英语、西班牙语、俄语和简体中文，技术说明为英语。两个工具仅提供只读指导，无需发布者账户或 API 密钥。
